arguments.summary: A low-severity port scan alert from IP 10.0.5.14 (WS-FIN-042) targeting 10.0.4.1 was escalated following correlation with historical IDS alerts and EDR telemetry. Investigation revealed that WS-FIN-042, a high-criticality finance workstation, had been compromised via a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell payload. This led to the execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon (C2 communication to 198.51.100.23) and subsequent lateral movement attempts via SMB and Kerberos. The host was running outdated software and allowed outbound traffic to a known malicious IP. Although containment actions were proposed, they were blocked due to consensus failure. A full EPP scan detected a Linux dropper, suggesting cross-platform threats. The incident highlights gaps in detection sensitivity, response automation, and playbook coordination.
